zalrpakraft.journal.p1:
If you're reading this, I'm talking to myself again. Only on paper now.

At least someone might answer. Or not. I'm used to it.
zalrpakraft.journal.p2:
I don't know who you are. Not so sure who I am either.

Woke up on the grass, empty hands, wind in my head. Counted days in notches on a birch. Then the birch burned. Lightning, I think. Or me.
zalrpakraft.journal.p3:
Don't think I'm kind. There's no one here to be kind for.

I write because the silence is the loudest thing here. Sheep don't listen. Cows do, but they look at me like I owe them.
zalrpakraft.journal.p4:
My house isn't far.

X: %1$s
Z: %3$s

Height about %2$s, unless the ground moved again. It does that here. I've seen it.

The door isn't locked. Locked against whom.
zalrpakraft.journal.p5:
There's a table inside. I didn't put it there. It was already standing when I came. Warm, like someone just got up from it.

Put your palm on it. It shows a sky that isn't there.
zalrpakraft.journal.p6:
Stars and planets, beautiful enough to make you sick. And the things that fall.

I thought they were rocks too. No. They're alive. They sit in ice, in the deep, in fire. They don't like guests.
zalrpakraft.journal.p7:
They leave things behind. Things make keys. Hell won't let you in without one, I tested that with my forehead on obsidian.

And eyes. Twelve. The frame wants every one, each its own. It spits out the ordinary kind.
zalrpakraft.journal.p8:
I had eleven.

Eleven.

I went for the twelfth alone. It was big and I was alone. The failing isn't what hurts. It's having no one to tell how exactly I failed.
zalrpakraft.journal.p9:
Sometimes I think I'm writing to myself. To whoever wakes on the same grass tomorrow and remembers nothing again.

If so, hello. You look awful. Eat something.
zalrpakraft.journal.p10:
Last thing.

Don't go alone. Not because it's dangerous. Because afterwards you write books into the void and feel glad when the void finds them.

N.
zalrpakraft.journal.p11:
(the pages after this are torn out.

I tore them.

it was worse there)
